rationale: The assistant pointed to airflow restriction from a dirty filter or blockage, advised cold-water washing with 24h drying, and guided the customer to check the wand. That led to the fix and no part was suggested. Weaknesses: the first reply assumed two filters (the V8 has only one post-motor filter), and the second repeated the wand-blockage advice and did not ask about the cleaner head or the bin inlet. It also wrongly suggested the radiator could be an issue without warning clearly against direct heat. The closing advice that fine dust packs into the filter is somewhat speculative, and it gave no clear washing schedule or Dyson support fallback.
